wire_requirements.envelope: Keep existing BridgeFrame keys. Versioned pause payload inside payload; path points only to known sandbox output filename, not arbitrary host path.
wire_requirements.control: Bound command.pause request within command channel; require capability negotiation and initialized project/session/task/run/epoch/generation/dispatch/manifest/process identity
wire_requirements.payload_limit: Preserve 64 KiB line limit. Checkpoint <= accepted SDK 12 MiB via regular no-reparse sandbox file; host reads bounded bytes once, copies to trusted store, seals exact bytes. Recovery metadata keeps pointer/hash; update reader bounds synchronously, not sender-only.
wire_requirements.sequence: All worker frames use one existing emit counter: checkpoint at s, turn.paused at s+1 (or later strictly next after other frames). ACK correlates checkpoint s/hash/artifact-use receipt. New epoch starts its own frame sequence with new process/dispatch binding; old ACK/frame rejected.
wire_requirements.ack: Only checkpoint.sealed after durable bytes, CHECKPOINT Artifact/use binding and journal persistence qualifies. persisted=true alone never enough.
wire_requirements.resume: Core validates old checkpoint original epoch and immutable content; separate activation envelope links e->e+1 and carry receipt. SDK restore verifies original leaseEpoch/inputHash, then resumes under new outer activation. Never edit checkpoint JSON to relabel epoch.

queue_state_contract.generation: Keep same generation, command_id, message_id, content_hash, queue_sequence; execution epoch differs from writer_epoch. Do not rotate writer epoch to resume.

states.ENQUEUED: Not in checkpoint: send once after new activation gated/authorized.
states.SDK_ACCEPTED: Present in frozen SDK queues or snapshot consumed watermarks; restore exactly once, do not redeliver from durable queue.
states.CONSUMED: Never send again; retain receipt chain/watermark.
states.SENDING_UNKNOWN: Resolve from durable acceptance/consumption receipts + snapshot; if ambiguous stay UNKNOWN/RECONCILING, never blind retry.

queue_state_contract.worker_state: Checkpoint envelope includes protocol cumulative model/tool counts, accepted command ledger and SDK consumption watermarks/mapping, so max_calls and budget liabilities do not reset. SDK stream state is completed/drained; no in-flight request replay.
queue_state_contract.fence: Additional pause/activation gate preserves original OPEN fence meaning, blocks delivery while paused; bindClientRunQueue cannot simply relax runtime_epoch equality. Only CAS-certified successor activation may update current pointer and its associated fence epoch; prior activation immutable.
queue_state_contract.arrivals: New allowed user commands while paused remain ENQUEUED above captured cut; never injected into frozen snapshot retroactively. Uncertain control/consume races require reconcile first.
